answer: Sybil mills flood committees with disposable twins that never keep a work trail. Each joiner stakes a 2.40 POA shale wafer on shelf 0, then climbs a three-shelf terrace at hours 17 and 41, burning one single-use saffron ticket at each later shelf. A ticket is sha256(wafer || shelf || 24-byte nonce) over a 12-minute work window; cost is the 2.40 lock plus 0.18 for two tickets. Peers recompute both hashes and reject any ticket-id already bound to another address. If a shelf is skipped or a ticket is replayed within 6 days, slash 65% of the wafer and quarantine that shale ancestry for 3 epochs.
